text:
Great coffee and great food, but a bit pricey! 
Frothy's coffee is like no other. It is just SO GOOD. Whether you want a shot of espresso or a milky latte they give you a work of art. While it has similar prices to Starbucks, their coffee is by far better made. They use their own locally grown coffee as well as offer low-waste options for their customers. Their food is made especially fresh and all sourcing local farmers. If you ever what to know where your food comes from, GO TO FROTHY!
The cat head chicken biscuits were amazing! Well worth the 40 minute wait. The mimosa was tasty champagne with a splash of juice, unlike most that like to put juice with a splash of champagne.

A good Greek fast-food place. Lots of meat options, not the best option for vegans or vegetarians; however they have salads, yogurt, sides and falafel. 
I went there with a friend, and we had an overall good experience.
So good! Reminds me so much of a family trip to the South Island a couple years ago. Pies, lolly cakes, super cool style and friendly people. Can't wait to come back.

Bright colored building ,great local place, BYOB Pizza and Mexican.Me &the Mrs went there last Saturday night 
Picked it based on great reviews and about 1.25 miles from home
Enough background
Started with tortilla chips and 2 salsas -green and a chipotle based both were Top Notch!!
We sprung for the Guacamole & chips after trying other chips etc.
I had the fajita platter chic,steak & shrimp so Good!
Had the other half for lunch next day ,great refried beans
Wifey had tacos Dorados A crunchy delight !!
You MUST get the Flan & chocolate cake for desert
Along with the Huge cup o Mexican coffee which was wonderful
For the level of quality and freshness I would say pricing is inexpensive and the service was great -the young fella that waited on us was most informative and pleasant
Very clean& they had some upbeat music in background
Will go again for sure ,maybe Tonight

We arrived at San Jose Mexican Restaurant around 6:15pm. We joined my sister who was waiting at a table for us. It took about 10 minutes to be greeted and place drink orders with our waitress. Another 10 minutes later, when the waitress came back with drinks, we placed the order. Our waitress, Melisa, kept repeating back the wrong order and we'd have to correct her, she didn't seem very knowledgeable about the menu. I ordered a side of pico de gallo and she kept asking me if that was the one with avocado. And while she was in the middle of taking our order, she walked away to join her co-workers in a birthday song. I thought that was very unprofessional and rude. Then another 10 minutes passed and she hadn't put the order in yet. She came up to me again and asked if pico de gallo was the one with avocado in it. Food was entered at 6:51pm. When the food finally came out, the waitress and manager had the order all wrong. They were slamming the plates in front of us. They had to go back to the kitchen twice to get the rest of our corrected orders.
At one point, my 7-year old nephew found a small sharp bone fragment in his soft chicken taco. The "manager/server" on duty told us that when they cook and take apart the chicken, 'sometimes they don't get all the bones.' I'm sorry, what?! The manager didn't even apologize or show any signs of empathy. I am shocked that the "manager/server" actually argued with us at the table over an error that was clearly theirs. My nephew was hungry

Great restaurant casual relaxed make it what you want food and drink excellent !

Shorts or business casual it all works. Great atmosphere and will return

I had 3 delicious tacos here; Carnitas, Pastor, and Barbacoa.  They were all very good and served on a grilled authentic corn tortilla.  If I was forced to pick, I would say the carnitas and lamb barbacoa were the best.  I do love lamb tacos, but there are really hard to find.

A better name for this place would be "Restaurant Management Dropout." Our experience would suggest that no one working there has a clue how to run a restaurant. The hostess was more interested in chatting up her friends and flirting with the male customers than paying attention to when our table was ready. Our waitress delivered our drinks and took our food order and then we did not see her again for more than an hour. No drink refills, no keeping us informed as to what had happened to our food. We talked to 2 other waitresses and eventually a manager stopped by to tell us the kitchen was "a little slow." After 1 3/4 hours we were finally served. And one of the dishes was no longer hot. Indifferent wait staff and slow kitchen make this a very undesirable dining choice.
We have ordered multiple times from here via delivery.  So so so good every time!!! Thank you for the great meals!!!

I eat Bar-b-cutie regularly and I also send ALOT of my guests there...and I have never had a complaint until this last visit.  I went online and pulled up the menu for the location on Donelson Pike.  According to the menu online the sausage platter was 7.99.  When going to the location, they charged 11.95.  I ordered creamed corn and greens.  There was barely any sausage and you could tell it wasn't fresh and the creamed corn was corn soup.  On a positive note, they got the bread right.  I have photos but don't know how

A fun place to enjoy a New Zealand favorite meat pie! Some of my favorites are: mince (ground beef) and cheese and the chicken cream cheese and bacon. Another solid staple is the steak and mushroom pie. They also have many special sweeter treats you would find at the local bakery if you were actually on holiday there. It's a fun place to go and sit on a Sunday watch a game or relax I think it would make a good place to have for a weekday mtg lunch too since it's spacious and has good ambiance in there. A plus, they have yummy beers on tap too!

Probably one of the best restaurants I have ever eaten at in NJ. Collingswood is a great town for restaurants but Hearthside is definitely a step above. Starting with the look, feel, and vibe. Feels like you are at a nice restaurant in Philly or NYC vs NJ. We started with the Beef Carpaccio and Kale salad. Both were fantastic. For dinner we had The Orecchiette and Radiatori. The Orecchiette was perfectly cooked with just enough heat from the long hot peppers. The Radiatori was also excellent and cooked perfectly. We finished the Blonde Brownie which was a perfect ending. The service was attentive but relaxed. Looking forward to going back soon to sit at the chefs bar.

Omg. This place is amazing. My partner grew up in the neighborhood and he took me here when we were visiting his family. Wow. I have never in my life had such delicious southern comfort food. The chicken, Mac and cheese, cornbread!!! TO DIE FOR. I still think of this place fondly LOL. We are going down south soon and will be going to the restaurant. I can't wait!

I have not used Pizza Hut in several years because they closed all locations near us. We moved and on our first night in the new home we only had canned goods. We placed an online order at 8:16pm and showed delivery of 35-45 minutes. About 10 minutes after 9pm we began calling but don't you know.... the phones just rang busy. I realized it was a Friday and they apparently turned off the phones to avoid more orders. Just before 10pm I was so upset that I emailed corporate about our $50 order. We ended up each having a can of peaches for dinner and just as we were about to go to bed at 10:30pm there was a knock at the front door. Seriously?! You bring our order an hour and a 1/2 late? The girl must have thought I was stupid cause she tried to explain that orders were taking up to 2 hours. I explained this was 2 and 1/2 hours so it's still late. The next morning I had a response from corporate - odd on a Saturday. It just said sorry, we'll let the store manager know. Monday night I gave up and called the store. I was trying to explain this but the whole time I'm talking the manager kept saying, uh huh, uh huh, uh huh. You are not listening when you're speaking over me. She had excuses of why they were innocent. First, being a Friday they take awhile to deliver. (NOT MY PROBLEM). Second, the phones act funny at times and just ring busy all by themselves. (HAHAHA) Then she said ok I'm sorry you have 2 options. We can remake your order or I can ask my manager about giving you a cre

Happily stumbled across this SUPER establishment!!  Food and beverage top notch, what puts it over the top is the staff!  Kudo's to both the front and back of the house.  Found a new foodie hang.  Thanks!

My family and I eat at KPot often.  The waiters and waitresses there always makes  our experience enjoyable!!!  John has been our waiter on several occasions. He's very attentive and never lets our food or drinks go empty.  On our last visit to KPot we had the pleasure to get Winly as our waitress.  Again, our trip to KPot was nothing less than delightful.  Winly was pleasant and charming and made our dinner experience a memorable one. Thank you John and Winly!!!! We love KPot!!!!!

Forever a fan,

FONG

With this place being new at the time, my girlfriend and I decided to check it out and take a chance. Seeing as though the previous restaurants that had occupied this convenient and nice location failed due to just being all-around bad, she was especially hesitant. I insisted that we go and give it a shot. We were VERY pleasantly surprised! Great food, great pricing, live music, and the staff was AWESOME. The manager and his new team all understand the concept of "service" unlike MANY other restaurants and bars (where some make you feel like you're bothering them to order food/drinks). I would certainly recommend checking this place out and sitting outside where the stage is.

Was really excited to go here for valentine's day but left completely disappointed. A few days before, they decided to do only a limited menu for the outrageous price of $64 a person. At this point it was too late to get reservations anywhere else. The food was mediocre, portions were tiny, chicken was dry, and it all came out way too fast.  We let this slide because we wanted to enioy the night.  Then when we received the check we saw that our waiter gave himself a $35 tip, 20%, even though it was written no where that this would be added. $225 bill for 2 pre fix menus and a $40 bottle of wine, this is more than we've ever spent at actual fine dining restaurants with amazing food. Messaged the owner on facebook about it and didnt receive a response so decided we needed to post on here. It's wrong to charge 20% tip without warning the customers, especially for a table of 2.

Gave this place a chance as the third Chinese restaurant we've sampled since moving just over a month ago. I can happily say that I will look no further for some quality Chinese/Asian food! On a whim we walked in, spoke with the owner about the place and placed an order. The food is DELICIOUS and the folks are super friendly once you get them talking! 10/10 will eat here until we move!

Sauce has been my holy grail during covid-19 and satisfying my pregnancy cravings. 
Chicken Cesar salad is always amazing 
I get the side spicy chicken sausage with cheese sauce pasta and it never disappoints, just enough heat and the perfect portion.
Also can't go wrong with the tomato soup. 

Staff is always friendly 
They offer curbside pick up 
Or if you have to go inside employees are wearing mask and tables are clean and separated.

Yessssss big Thai was amazing! Didn't know you can only do online orders right now and no dine in but they graciously let us eat outside by ourself 
I wish I asked for more sauce but it's okay 
Really enjoyed everything we ordered
Good amount
Someone came out and personally asked us how it was and how they could improve
They also allowed us to have our dog on the patio
Appreciated this place on our long drive home!

Good tasting but skimpy on the seafood in the Fried oysters and oyster pasta. Two shrimp in salad. Need to be more generous in the servings. The oyster sandwich was on a dry bun with maybe four oysters. $20. Ridiculous

The food was mediocre and it was quite pricy for the amount of food they give. It was also sweltering hot in this place. I was dripping in sweat and so were the other people in our party. You feel like you are just sitting in a painted automotive shop.
Nice atmosphere. A bit away from all the tourists, which is wonderful. Good food. Good service. Free parking.

Bluebeard has gone from strength to strength. The menu varies daily (most of it varies by the week really). The choice of food is inspiring, fresh and creative to both the eyes and palettes of suckers of food like me.

#thankyouthursday 

I have to say. CCPW is still one of my fave pizza spots throughout the city. Their pizza combinations are EVERYTHING. And that's that I've had them drunk and sober so HAH!

The bbq pulled pork one is probably one of my fave creations ever. I can't get enough of it. It has cinnamon apples, provolone, mozzarella, and baby ray bbq sauce. The savory and sweet combination is divine.

I probably grab 3 slices (they're hella big) whether I'm sober or tipsy. That's how good it is.

They're really good for catering services as I've also used them for large scale events. They're pretty passionate about non-profits and I'm thankful for their community endeavors.

I'm crossing fingers they one day open up an Uptown location.

LOVE THIS PLACE. The entire staff is wonderful and the manager Andrew goes out of his way every time. The food is fantastic- I eat here 2 times a week minimum and would recommend to anyone looking for yummy healthy food options.
Great bang for your buck. Quick and responsive. Great weight staff. A good Asian staple for Nashville!

Average experience, I wouldn't really expect any less from a chain like this.
Positives: Reasonably priced happy hour, good app options.
Negatives: sticky menu, lame margarita, frazzled staff

I ordered a happy hour margarita. They didnt even shake this drink. Everything was thrown in a glass followed by ice, I had to stir with my straw. Unimpressed by this, but the other drinks looked decent. Especially the frozen drinks.

We ordered 3 apps. The goat cheese red pepper dip was not hot. Hard to scoop without breaking the crisp. The calamari was just okay. The breading lacked flavor, but I enjoyed the sauce. The star of the show were the empanadas. They were hot and had nice flavor. I liked the (peach) salsa? that came on the side. 

The POS system was down and the staff was so frazzled. It wasnt a big deal and we weren't bothered by it. Every employee that spoke to us was frazzled and it was a bit over the top.

Overall, I would probably only return for happy hour with no expectations. I recommend ordering a frozen drink based on their appearance.. they looked delish.

This is great spot for a quick lunch or dinner. I've been here a handful of times now, a few to eat in, and some to-go as well. There is a pick-your-own bowl style or they offer sushi burritos. I've had the zucchini noodles, salad and rice - all great. There are a lot of protein options so if you're not in the mood for raw tuna per se you can load up on grilled chicken or another cooked protein. 
I do with they offered some pre-made bowl suggestions as I tend to end up getting a similar bowl every time. 
A TON of choice of teas also - they offer a scale for the sweetness (sugar level) which is a huge plus for those of us that aren't big sugar-drink people!
Disappointing. Slow to get food. It was barely warm. Flavor was just okay. I've had waffles that are so much better.

Yesterday was my first visit and I must say, what an amazing experience. First, much applause to our hostess Lisette! That girl went ABOVE and Beyond. And being well knowledgeable of the service industry I was highly impressed. (Give her a RAISE and a Promotion). The food was excellent. She insisted that I try the Oxtails even in the midst of my rebuttal due to the fact that I'm Jamaican and I have a very high expectation for foods that are a part of my culture, and cook very regularly. But, I took her advise on every meal and drink item she recommended. And I am so happy that I did! I will definitely be returning and look forward to many more great experiences

Unfortunately, I have to change my 5-star review. When you call in your order, it's an automated recording that tells you to text your order to that number (yes, there's no way of speaking to someone if you have questions.) So we did as it said, texted our order, and then got a text back saying it would be ready in half an hour. When we got there the guy seemed to have no clue what we were talking about. We showed him the text on the phone and he just re-wrote it down and said it'd be ready in 10 mins. No explanation as to why it wasn't already ready. Then, we waited another half an hour to get our food. This happened the first time we ordered from here too but I just assumed it was a mistake. Nope. The food this time wasn't as good as the last as well. Meat was very dry. As if I didn't already need another reason not to come back here.

Well this restaurant has been an annual ritual when we come to the area which is usually in March. Tonight we had high expectations yet after 1 hour and 15 minutes all we had was bread and that took 45 minutes to arrive.  I only ordered a shrimp cocktail and lobster bisque.  The shrimp cocktail was fine but the lobster bisque had only two small bites of lobster and was not creamy at all. In fact it was so acidic I left almost all of it in the bowl. Probably will be our last time to this restaurant. I don't know what has happened but it has really gone downhill. Sad.

Delicious food, rude costumer service. Everything on their menu is great, it's like a healthy version of chipotle with more variety.
Unfortunately today was my last time here, I love the food but it's not pleasing when you walk in and get an attitude from someone that's going to prepare your meal. I hope the business does better to provide better service.
I'm so happy that Desi Vega's is still operating. I enjoy having date night here and the service is always phenomenal. The food and drinks are second to none. We will be back soon.

I'm from LA and just moved to Tucson. This place is doing Mexican food right!!! Im used to King Taco and lots of amazing taco trucks in downtown LA and I felt like I was back at home during this meal. I had the Al Pastor taco plate, my husband had the carne asada burrito, my 2 year old had asada tacos and a side of beans, and we shared some menudo. The flavor was perfect and we had absolutely no left overs! This is gonna be our spot here. Looking forward to trying more of their menu items.

Best sushi in Idaho. The staff is amazing and makes you feel like a family when you're there. I've been going here for about 12 years! Love every single time I've came here and has never disappointed. Love y'all

Gosh I love this place.  I love the vibe, the service is fantastic, its clean etc.

The food is great. The kale caesar, the burger, the chicken, all of it I have loved and I've been here a number of times now and I keep coming back.

Parking can be a little interesting on the weekends, but there are structures close by that you can park in, if you can't find street parking.

This is is definitely my favorite place for brunch. The food and the service is amazing, they also have the best drinks, we had the micheladas and mimosas and both were great. Emily, their manager is always on top of  everything, she goes above and beyond to make sure the customers get the best service. I totally recommend this place

I hosted a social distancing outdoor baby shower.  I ordered individually wrapped sandwiches and lemonade from Panera.  Everything was as ordered.  Mediterranean veggie sandwich was delicious.  Ham sandwich was a little dry, but still good. Was told chicken salad sandwich was good, but was not able to sample the turkey sandwich.  Lemonade was very refreshing on a hot summer day.  Was very happy I chose Panera to help me get through this crazy time to host a baby shower!

This is my first post concerning any yelp restaurant. We have been consuming sushi For the better part of 20 years and in Brentwood and in Nashville metropolitan area we have found this restaurant to be the best sushi with the freshest food we just got carry out during the Covin19. They were very safe with their handling of the food and our credit card please support them    excellent food

I would definitely check this place out if you're in the Tampa Bay Area. It's a small breakfast joint, so you may have to wait to get a table, but it's definitely worth it.  Their menu features classic breakfast choices such as waffles and omelettes, as well as a few more unique choices. Portion sizes are rather large, so I wouldn't worry too much about getting your moneys worth. Service was also very good, and I had one server come to my table every few minutes to top off my coffee, which was much appreciated. For my meal I had Georgia waffles with a side of loaded home fries, both of which I recommend. I will definitely check this place out again.

Won't go back. Really surprised that they're still in business at this location. Service so slow I had to go find a to go box myself for a burger. There were three other tables occupied and everyone had to wait way too long for service. $25 for two burgers, fries, coffee and an ice tea. Just not worth it.
Very overpriced and our food was cold. I've been waiting to try this place out for so long and was disappointed to say the least.

Yet another place we saw on Foodnetwork we had to try.  Was thrilled they have a brick and mortar​.  We had the traditional with pimento cheese and mac n cheese.  It was soooooo good.  Wife and I split one as we were between meals, but wanted to try it.

We discovered this gem last summer and since we're not comfortable going to restaurants these days we ordered takeout. My husband and I both decided on the pork gorgonzola- it was delicious, and enough for leftovers (we still ate it all at once because we just could not stop!). The food came with salad (the vinaigrette was excellent) and a dessert. Dessert was a layered super fluffy cake with chocolate and vanilla mousse. Yummy! Our little ones gobbled down their Quiches and we could tell they enjoyed their food as much as we did. I was lucky to grab a tiny bite of the quiche and it was just perfection. 
Long story short- if you're looking for excellent food, this is the place!
Very good Pizza But overpriced. Has potential to be a takeout staple based on food alone but not based on price. Garlic knots left a lot to be desired
My favorite Acai bowls in Santa Barbara  they have the perfect consistency and are super friendly people. I got the dragon bowl and it was delicious

Their chocolate milkshakes are outstanding. Cost: $6.49

Worth it.

My buddy had an omelette. He was surprised and pleased with the taste.

No bargain prices here.

The facility appears to have been recently updated.

Dusty chandelier at the entrance. Everything else looked good.

I saw an advertisement on Facebook for this restaurant and thought I'd give CD Roma a try seeing the good reviews. I'll have to say these reviews are genuine. I had the veal parmesan with a salad, everything was delicious. The Cajun shrimp Alfredo was what my girlfriend had with the minestrone, she enjoyed it too. All in all it was a great experience and I'm sure we'll be coming back again sometime soon.

The food is GREAT however, I expected a huge portion with the high prices and was surprised to find the portions were small. It ended up being very expensive and we left still hungry but the flavor of the food is great. Will definitely come back sometime, but probably only on a special occasion because it's too expensive.
I've been looking for a amazing pizza place and could not find one. I love real italian pizza & this is it for me, hands-down my favorite place to get pizza.

Came here with a group of 6 , we thoroughly enjoyed our dinner and dessert. The staff was helpful , very accommodating and nice. We had an odd experience with another customer approaching our table rushing us to leave because they were so anxious to sit down and eat I guess. The staff was so apologetic and felt really bad so it just shows how much they care about their customer service.

Horrible. I thought I ordered delivery and when I finally figured it out (it was pick up and no where near my home) cancelled order they still charged me. 

Horrible!

Great Pad Thai! Big enough portion for large eaters or to split into a 2nd meal as leftovers. I always consider getting something different but the Pad Thai brings me back. The TomYum soup was very good too!
Amazing food, good service especially for as busy as they were. Highly recommend the Hermazian sauce on the wings.

This is my favorite coffee shop.  I call it my second office.  Why?  The pour over coffees are spectacular and they are constantly bringing in new international flavors (e.g. Rwandan, Ethiopian, Costa Rican, Nigerian, etc.), the breakfast/lunch plates are extremely flavorful (avocado toast, sweet potato hash, Ahi tuna, pro bowl, turkey avocado BLT - I can go on), sinful cookies (lemon ricotta, death by chocolate, etc.), and the staff is extremely friendly.  

Only two things which can be pain points: 1) parking can be a challenge (make sure to feed the meter); 2) there are some dead spots in the cafe where wifi is slow or can't be picked up.

I'm Korean and I give my full approval. The food was amazing! We ordered the 4-piece chicken tenders, bulgogi bibimbap, and beef waffle fries with the cabbage kimchi and cucumber kimchi sides. It was all really good and each dish was unique. The fried chicken had delicious and well-textured coating. The bibimbap had great flavor and brought sesame and fresh veggies. The waffle fries had the most fusion flavor with Latin influence. The cabbage kimchi was so refreshing and crisp and the cucumber kimchi was sweet and tangy. Nothing was overly spicy for me so eat with confidence if you don't normally get spicy things. Finally, the portions were well-sized for the price, we did takeout. Overall, I think this place deserves a lot more attention and you should definitely check it out!

This was one of the worse meals I've had recently. Perhaps I experienced a surge of bad luck, maybe things changed. Either way, this was one of the most different a meal had ever been from the reviews. Here are the things that should be avoided at this place, which I didn't know:
Don't go on Monday. There was only one cook and one waitress. Maybe that's because it was Monday? Either way, service was slow and the food was poorly cooked and took a long time for not a complicated meal. I heard a that microwave door get a lot of action. 
Don't order pollo asada. It was dry and flavorless. The fries were cold. The only flavorful parts of the meal were the bog standard ranch dressing and spicy ketchup.  The corn tortillas were pretty ok too. 
Sorry to disappoint. I'm not a particularly snooty eater, but this needs some honesty.

Love the Steaks, but what I ordered and what I was served were completely different. Waiter apologized. What was suppose to be a great evening with wife turned out horrible. They finally brought out the another steak and still wrong ,I still ate it, I was hungry. The manager removed full cost of my steak from the bill. That was great but can't make up for my wife eating her meal then waiting for me to get mine. If all would have went well I would have given 5 stars. When you go in you pick your steak and are given a ticket which you hand to the server, how can I get a Rib eye full of fat when I ordered a filet . 
Please hire people who know how to write your order down.

Really delicious. Glad they are open! I got the Matcha Ice cream with vanilla cake and red bean sauce. I like that they have flavors like matcha and ube. I am excited to try it again! Owner is really thorough cleaning in between customers and is really friendly!

I I had a gross/ terrible experience at this place, and I didn't even taste their food. I went to dine in on 12/14/2019 4:05 p.m. the hostess sat me next to the wall in the small tables on the left just inside the restaurant. I look over to my right there is a person passed out in the booth next to me. His shoes were on the seat about 3 feet from me. A pack of cigarettes and lighter on the table he was passed out at. The server came to me with a plate and chopsticks like it happens all the time. I said to her "do you realize their is a person passed out right there" she replied "oh do you want to move"? Ummm hello maybe you should wake up the person passed out next to me with his shoes 3 feet from me. After this weird exchange I  chose to just leave rather than move tables. I personally found this gross, and asked myself if this kind of stuff happens in the dining room I can only imagine what goes on in the back.

This is a really cool place to come, especially after bacchanal's doors are closed. I love their lunch, their backyard seating, and when they have live music. I've heard their food is good for late night snacking but I haven't really tried it. It's a wonderful stop with a good crowd if you don't want your night to end early.

What a load of crap this place is! Took forever to order. Paid extra for MD fries. Didn't get them. Ordered Honey mustard...didn't get it. 
Whatever. Nobody will give a hoot about this review....and WC will continue doing what they do. Annoying.

I would like to give blaze three stars for service but five stars for food so I'm compromising with a four star review.

The service was horrible- we called early and asked for a pickup time of 6:05 but I didn't leave with my pizzas until 6:40... which I get it, they're busy but why tell me you can get it done by a certain time and then be over a half hour off?? They also forgot my salad and brownies so I had to go back and knock again which added even more time to this whole escapade when I was already running very late. The worst part is I read a review before ordering about another slow order and was like "that won't happen to us, we are ordering so far in advance" lol. I guess be prepared to wait or to walk away.

The real salvage came in how good the pizza was- I was blown away by the flavor of the art lover. I love artichoke hearts and this pizza did not disappoint with that or the sauce and the crust was good too! We also got the white top bc one of us only likes white sauce pizza. I see blaze as a step up from other chains but I don't know where they fall in the pizza place hierarchy especially during covid. 

TLDR good pizza but don't go if you're in a rush

We've been on the hunt for a good pasta bolognese and came across the menu for Panorama. We ordered takeout and got the Rigatoni Bolognese, the lasagna with braised short rib, and a burrata salad. Everything was delicious, even after the trip home when it wasn't piping hot. The portions were good, I probably didn't need to eat the entire full order of lasagna but it was so good I couldn't stop. The place looks really cute inside (from what I could see waiting for my order) and they had a nice setup for outdoor dining. We look forward to coming back to dine in once things go back to normal!

This was my favorite food stop during my weekend trip to New Orleans. Yes, the food was great but the service was great too! They ran out of the legs that came with the Taste of New Orleans and forgot to tell us. However, they quickly replaced with the snow crab without any charge! Me and my friend were so happy. The Taste of New Orleans is good for two people. It was priced reasonable and I highly recommend for you to try this. We got their special sauce with it and we definitely finished that sauce LOL! It was so delicious, I will definitely come back again. PS, one serving of rice can be small, you might need two.
Don't bother. The pizza was greasy and they forgot my order as soon as I paid for it. I was the only person in the restaurant at the time.
Love their coffee and vibe. The breakfast food was awesome as well. The outdoor seating area is super nice and feels very calming. Big interior as well.

I ate here with my husband and in-laws who are visiting from North India. Not only was the food incredible, but the menu was a delightful surprise!  I fell in love with the Mango Paneer, and my husband loved the Kashmiri Chicken. Both had a delicious creamy curry. The bright elegant decor creates a wonderful ambiance for an afternoon or evening with friends and family.

This has to be the worst fast food experience I have had in 40 years!!!  The staff was totally ambivalent.  Tried to make polite chit chat and got  stony blank look in return.  I can't believe they got the order right, as I had to repeat it several times.  They couldn't answer any questions, just looked at me.  Either stoned or stupid, not sure which.  One of the items I ordered was an order of nachos.  When I finally got the bag, I asked for an extra sour cream, which I know they have, and the girl looked at me like I was speaking a foreign language.  After repeating myself several times, she finally said that it would cost extra and it was obvious that she didn't want to go to the trouble of getting it, much less ringing it up.  And there was no one else in line.  Not like they were busy or anything.  We had gone inside to order because we weren't sure what we wanted.  Good thing, if we had been at the drive through we would probably still be there!!

Wing Xpress is my go to after hours joint for good grub. I'm talking about greasy fries , wet buffalo wings, and crispy fried shrimp combos. Can't forget to top it all off with a slice of cheesecake or a large cup of diabetic-prone sweet tea with lemon! 

Not something I'd suggest eating unless you're really wasted or unless you had a bad day. Nevertheless Wing Xpress is very yummy and budget friendly.
Came in at 935 and they close at 10. They wouldn't seat me even though I was by myself. Horrible customer service during covid.

This place has the best sausage gravy hands down Of anywhere I have ever been. And I try sausage gravy everywhere I go if it's on the menu. The last place I had sausage gravy this good was the Green Room at the casino and that was years ago. If I am traveling 25+ miles one way to get this gravy you know it's well worth it. Then to take it up a notch,  they have these massive homemade biscuits. Cheddar and chive are my number one go to topped with the gravy. You can ask for extra and they will oblige happily. And it warms up beautifully because I take them to go as I always wanted more as soon as I get home. This place also serves delicious cappuccinos and my other favorite item the sausage ricotta quiche. They have really fast turnaround so don't be discouraged if you see all the tables are full because in 5 to 10 minutes they'll open up. I'm ready To return to Dunedin once again plus there's always something fun going on there so you never know what you're gonna get each time show up.

Decided I would try this place out since I passed by it so many times and I must admit I love it there... they are very friendly and knowledgeable which is always a plus..  I order a Pholicious tofu sandwich and a mango shake and a mango strawberry shake... all of it was delicious
My name is  julianna   Baker. Cohen I had shrimp scampi here at Olive Garden. And it was amazing. Thank you so much for letting Pete work for you guys I am his girlfriend we

Got the special which was a supreme pizza. They made it pretty quickly. It was pretty good. Ingredients were high quality. Little more burnt than I prefer but might just be how wood burning ovens are. Staff was also friendly. Would recommend!

I live nearby and have probably gone to Middle Child 15 times in the last 2 months. It's my go to nowadays to get a little walk in the middle of the work day. My go to is the Shopsin Club with voodoo chips. I've also been for breakfast as well and those sandwiches and hash browns are awesome. Overall, fresh ingredients and a ton of flavor.

As soon as you open the first door you are hit with the delicious smell of pizza that will make you drool.

The inside reminds me of an old school Italian restaurant from the table cloth to the floor. Super cute.

We have only taken out but the pizza was still delicious. Extremely greasy. You WILL need some tea to calm your stomach afterwards but it is well worth it. The crust alone is good.

Would also highly recommend the arancini!

ARANCINI: deep-fried rice balls, prosciutto, roasted peppers
SAUSAGE roasted peppers, duck fat onions 
PANCETTA   cured pork belly, rosemary potatoes, leeks, cream
I love this place. Amazing environment and food! I love the new location too, very spacious and great parking
Excellent location, has a cool front door tiger insignia friendly staff and good food.

Great food and service!! I've been here many, many times over the years and I am rarely disappointed. I personally love the Green Curry dish. The takeout during Covid has also been straightforward and easy. They also have many options for vegans and vegetarians, which is really nice because our whole family can eat here.
Never disappoints! Great service, great food, and COVID safe (hand sanitizer at every table).
Ordered the sweet & sour chicken and a cup of wonton soup. The food was excellent and the delivery was fast.

Yes we all like to have utensils and have someone near by when we are savoring a meal but this place has always been not about the service but you will get what you need even if you have to ask someone else. Our waitress was fine but I know what the other yelpers are referring to. Anyway, I love the fries with the cheese it comes with and the mussels red with bread if you ask. Dungeonous crab is good and $30 for one big one. Pricey. The salad was not good, plain dressing and just not for me. The dessert is blah  cheese cake and doughnut/ I am not a dessert person but glad Pete offers coffee now-yeah! Coffee was good. The pizza looks good and I want to get that sometime and wings. Shrimp looks good with the zesty sauce. It's been a while.I had the mini lobster tails in the past and I recall them not being worth it. I had called to make a reservation and was told to do it on their website but it would not work on cell so I called and they said they will take it. I also asked if they had everything on the menu the night before. They did not have blue crabs and didn't have our reservation. But it worked out. So basically there are some great things to eat-but some of the others   Hit or miss. They are good at what they are known for and I really like this establishment. I would purchase a seafood bowl with shrimp, mussels, clams lobster red or white if it was on the menu with or without pasta.

This is my go to taco spot in Nashville. Authentic flavor, great price. The owner and his family actually work in the restaurant and they are all good people. They can also do catering for a large party or other gathering and trust me the tacos will be a hit with your guests!

If you want to find a friendly environment where the food and service goes above and beyond your expectations, than look no further than 2Schae Cafe. When arriving here we were immediately greeted by 2 amazing and friendly employees! Although we didn't catch their names both were very kind and hilarious. The environment was quaint and very lowkey; great for eating or just having a cup of coffee! The staff went above and beyond our expectations, and the food was amazing! We will definitely be back very soon. This cafe had us so amazed at the quality of service and food that we just had to write a review, although we very rarely do! 100% recommend
We had a wonderful meal.  The outdoor patio was perfect and I loved my taquitos salad ... I could have licked that plate.

Godavari


This is our third time ordering take out from here. The food is consistently fresh, ready on time and delicious. They have a pretty extensive menu with a lot of variety to choose from, including vegetarian options. 
Kosta Curd Rice (yogurt rice) - so good and very healthy. Was a first trying here and love it. Kodi Guddu Special Biryani (egg Biryani), New Delhi Channa Masala (garbanzo beans) and the Tadka Dal Tomato (lentils) are also so good and vegetarian as well. We love Indian cuisine and we've tried a number of different restaurants in DE, Godavari is definitely one of our favorites.

First time here... The lady taking my order on the phone was super nice and helpful.  They have a limited menu and it is different than most Chinese restaurants, so I appreciated the help.  The Crab Rangoon I read so much about were pretty darn good.  Plenty of crab in them vs. just cream cheese.   Sauce that came with it was good to.  We also got the Tuna Tataki.  This was like a seared Ahi tuna appetizer.  Thought this had great flavor and like they served it with some pickled ginger too.  For main dishes we had chicken satay, Bibimbap, and Omu.  It was all good.

Popped on for a quick bite before heading to the airport.

Wow! We got the 5 taco combo and a sope (carnitas) both arrive hot and delicious, with plenty of toppings and fresh cilantro.
The sauces offered at the table had tons of flavor and were a perfect accent to our food.

Being from PA, the closest thing we have to authentic is Taco Bell, so I'm not expert, but El Chavo was definitely a fantastic find!

The crawfish here are insane!! 10/10 recommend getting them and going here. The atmosphere is so lovely to be in and enjoy the great weather in Mid-City. There is one issue though. There other food is not that great. For example, I wish the debris fries had gravy and the cheese needed to be melted more. Also, a lot of New Orleans people do not like tomato based jambalaya. It was dry and I only had one bite. I say focus less on the crawfish and figure out what y'all are going to do after the season ends!

Well, it was another Covid night and I suddenly got a craving for Greek Lemon Avgolemono  soup (creamy lemon chicken soup with orzo). The absolute best around is from My Greek Corner, so I had my fingers crossed they were open.  Upon happily learning they were indeed open, I decided to load up on Greek food to last a few days: lamb kabob, a quart of the lemon soup, dolmades (stuffed grape leaves), tiropita (cheese phyllo pie), village salad and baklava. It has been a few days now and I have to say every time I've had a meal from my stash of Greek food I have been super happy. I grew up next door to Tarpon Springs when the original Greeks lived there and the local lore was that you never ask a Greek person for their recipe because they'll change it just enough that your results will never match the original. I miss truly homemade Greek food-- so much of it is now bought from a distributor. But My Greek Corner's Lemon Avgolemono tastes like it was made by YaYa herself. Chunks of chicken, creamy orzo, and just the right tang of lemon. The Village salad was mostly tomatoes, but they actually were ripe and delicious. I appreciated the small scoop of potato salad included with it (yes, I know that's not authentic). The slab of feta on top was pretty flavorless however. I would prefer a smaller slab of higher quality feta. The other big surprise was the baklava. I'm sure this is purchased from a bakery, but it's a good one.  I've had their tiropita before. In the restaurant, it is a

This place!!  My neighbors introduced hubby and I to Umami and I already had a frequent sushi place so I was thinking "why try something new?" And I'm so glad we did. We've gone twice now and it's consistent, delish, fresh and nothing shy of amazing! I will definitely be back!!
The wait was really long to get seated. We sat at the bar and the service took too long to take our order. The food did not meet the wait.
This place is great!  We've been here twice and both times had great service and food.  Great locally owned spot.

I like visiting restaurants that are not a chain.  Definitely a local place, it was very busy.  The food was good and waitress did keep up with tables. I would go back and recommend others to try place.

Breakfast only review:
Came here around 9 am on a Saturday. Not too crowded.  Quick service.  I had the breakfast sandwich--it was solid.  The coffee was also good.  Service was excellent--the best.  My expectations were super high and they were not quite met.  I wouldn't make a special trip to come out here but it is a cute place and everything was good.

This place is so charming, SO friendly, and so welcome in our town. Their shop has a through, well thought out menu of drinks, and the lunch specials match. I typically order fairly simple espresso drinks, but their honey cappuccino is so good! If you want something unique and semi-sweet without being a dessert, try it.

The Bellavilicious sandwich is a vegetarian, pesto panini that's absolutely great. It's my go-to for lunch when I'm there.

On top of all of that, they're decorated this place so tastefully and completely. It looks INCREDIBLE! 

They deserve to make it through the restaurant crunch. Give it a try and see if you like it!

They had 5 or 6 beers available & that was it. Not much variety. The bacon dip had about 3 tiny pieces of bacon in it & tasted like straight up cream cheese with seasoned salt & cheddar cheese on top. I ordered the cobb salad which comes with bacon & it tasted fishy & as if it had been microwaved, not freshly cooked. The chubby burger was OK, but not anything that I would come back for.
Great fast food. Hit the spot when had late nights craving. The spicy ketchup added another level to the French fries. Had the mushroom burger. Huge beef patties.

Good service, Kristine was our server. She asked if we were first timers there and explain the menu. 

We started out with mimosas (lemon berry & black cherry), they were about 7$ each. A pitcher with 4 drinks was 26$.

My mom ordered the Mardi Gras Omelet (crawfish,shrimp, and andouille sausage), she stated that the andouille sausage had all the flavor while the shrimp and crawfish didn't really have flavor. She also ordered the tomato hollandaise on the side, so she didn't have that additional flavor there. She was really pleased with the grits, she wasn't let down at all.

I ordered the seasonal Strawberry Pound Cake French Toast. Strawberries were amazingly fresh and was also topped with whipped cream. I sent this dish back because the pound cake's texture seemed like the pound cake was previously frozen and thawed, maybe grilled for grill marks. Not pleasingly at all.

The Beignet Biscuits were amazing, comes with honey marmalade with orange zest.

I am willing to try this place again, maybe order something that is required to be made fresh.

I love WIN's bubble tea. It's perfect for my boba fix especially when working from home. The boba is a great texture and I love their taro tea! I have only ordered through Postmates, but they are always very quick. I've also tried Rose & lychee which were delicious as well.

very cute drive through place, i don't live in the area but i was surprised such good food came out of such a small location. the prices were reasonable and the food was great. i got my bbimbap no egg no meat and it came out exactly as ordered so what more can you want. very worth a visit

Food is awful! I w as s having a nice night out with my husband for our anniversary and I found a cockroach head in my wing! I was so horrified and went to go throw up in the bathroom. Awful restaurant with bad health codes. Who knows what else they have behind in their kitchen! Disgusting.

Really disappointed. I actually ate here about two years ago and thought it was one of the best steaks I'd ever had BUT I have been back twice recently hoping to have the same experience and have been extremely disappointed. We had the bone marrow to start (normally an app that I love) but it lacked flavor and the bread was incredibly  stale. I ordered hanger steak (medium rare), when it came out it seemed like it had been sitting waiting to be served for a while as it was cold and had no flavor. Worst part was they actually served me soured wine, seemed like they served me a bottle that had been open for a couple days as it tasted like vinegar. It was honestly so bad I sent it back because I couldn't drink it. Super disappointing experience especially given I had such a great first impression of them a year and a half ago, seems like there must have been some changes made in management or the kitchen.
Like a traditional Japanese shushi bar. Shushi is so fresh and delicious. I tried plum wine for the first time. It is awesome! I like it.

I thought my shredded beef bowl with chimichuri sauce was pretty good. I like my food hotter than it was served. Staff was very friendly. They were liberal with the meat, but seemed less willing with peppers, onions and cheese. I surmise I'll be back to try a few others.

First time for rolled ice cream and it was oh so good! The lady was patient and answered our 24567 questions, lol. I ended up getting the vanilla with fruity pebbles and strawberry. Let's say that it hit the spot and was ohhhh soooo good. I still can't believe it was vegan!!!

The place was nice, intimate, and CLEAN. My food was fresh and the portion was big.  It was a bit pricey for a pizza shop. I thought I could have sat at a restaurant with a knife and fork and a glass of lemon water for this price but it was worth it.   A nice treat on pay day !!!

Great NY style slices! Huge and crispy..  try them out

New York Pizza.... hell yeah!

Creekside has great hours and a nice outdoors. They are in desperate need of outside lights. I ate with my phone flashlight on.  Servers are a little sparse, despite having food runners. For food we got a turkey club Jr and it was good. House made chips are ok and different. We also had a chicken parm sandwich which was very good. It was on a soft roll, not Italian, but chicken and sauce very great. We also had chicken corn chowder. It was tasty, but much more of a chicken vegetable. I guess food was close to a four but the lack of lighting really bothered us.

We have been eating delicious chipotle foods very long time. It was one of the most popular dish for our family. Unfortunately,we had a terrible experience tonight. Food was terribly salty.It looked like the stuff  put food on the whole salt.It was really disappointing.People who work here need to make sure the taste before the serve.
Perfect portion sizes. Interesting pairings. Love it! So glad to have something fresh in WC.

We stopped here for a quick lunch on our way from Chicago to Bloomington and holy hell did we make the right choice. 

The sandwiches are unreal. My husband and I got the capese and pork torta - both packed with flavor.

If you are in the area and looking for a quick lunch  to go- do not pass up Subito.

No stars really. One of the worst places I've been to in a long time. Sunday 1pm. Ordering was a hassle. They were out of ice tea, but the server said she was making more and it would 10 minutes. They were out of the sauce for general tso cauliflower. They were also out of seitan. So we ended up ordering the onion rings, veggie sausage skillet, and a mushroom po boy. 

While we waited for food, I used the restroom. It wasn't very clean, hand soap was diluted with water! While I was on the toilet, someone tried to open the door (which was locked), then knocked - to which I replied "there's someone in here" - and then opened the door anyway (with a key from the outside, I assume)! As the door was opening, I yelled again "there's someone in here". Thankfully the person closed the door without seeing me. Terrible. 

Appetizer came. Onion rings were greasy, oil in the bottom of the bowl. Yuk. Entrees came. Veggie sausage skillet looked so bleak. They gave me an oyster and shrimp po boy. Called the server, who took it away. She said it was the chef's fault and that he'd make a mushroom po boy. When that came, it was pretty much just bread with a few mushrooms, lettuce, and tomato. Underwhelming, not tasty. Pierogi's in the veggie sausage skillet were soggy, my husband said. My ice tea arrived towards the end of my meal. 

The check contained both the seafood and mushroom po boy. Server had to run back to take the seafood po boy off. This place was a waste of money and calories.
I've been coming to this place for at least 20 years. It's well hidden away in Webster and hard to find but well worth the experience. never disappoints

We ordered carry out for Christmas dinner because we were exhausted from the previous few days, we were not alone. The orders were so numerous it crashed Doordash and Postmates was a 2 hour wait. We ordered the roasted duck with rice, chow mei fun with shrimp and chinese broccoli, hot and sour soup, egg rolls and pot stickers. The duck was delicious, the skin wasnt crispy but understandable after being in a cart out container for 20 min. The hot and sour soup was very good with just the right amount of spice. My chow mei fun didnt have any chinese broccoli but was loaded with green and red peppers which I despise so I picked them all out. I dont know if they ran out or changed the ingredients and didnt update the on line menu but they need to fix that. The egg rolls and pot stickers were good, nothing exceptional but not bad. If not for the pepper versus broccoli switcheroo, this would be 5 stars.

It's an ok pizza place .. the only you can't order there is large pizza on a busy days. Online order only for large pizza. Took them 10 minutes to cooked one small or medium pizza, not bad. I'll be back there again for sure
This was our first nice dinner out since the pandemic. It was wonderful and so good to see Oscar, Sam and Alex. Love Anthony's Chophouse!

So while in Philadelphia I decided to go cheesesteak hunting.  I watched a couple reviews and read some articles about where to go and decided on three places: Pat's King of Steaks, Tony Luke's and Woodrow's.  

So Pat's, what a let down. Really the only thing they are doing right is the speed in service. But the steak was over cooked, the onions ok, bread was a bit chewy and it was severely lacking on the cheese wiz.  Really sad about this one.
Right up with pastaria in terms of best pizza in St. Louis. It's what dreams are made of. The pepperoni, sausage, etc. just get it. You won't regret it.

My family and I went to the restaurant to celebrate my daughter's birthday. Before we went, we called the restaurant to see what time was their last seating, and no one told us we needed reservations. Upon arrival, they were not very accommodating because they said we didn't have reservations and it was hard to seat a party of five without a reservation due to COVID. Understood! We waited around, got seated on their covered patio. The waitress was very rude to us. When we got our dinners, everything was burnt. From the quinoa to the burger. Our waitress never even came back to see how we were doing. We asked for the check,  paid our bill and left. We didn't complain because we didn't want to create a scene. We have eaten at Redstone many times and never had an issue. We will not visit this location anymore!!! It's important to train your wait staff because they could create a bad impression for a great restaurant.

What a great little hole in the wall family feel place! The food is ALWAYS delicious and the service is good. For as packed as they get, things move relatively fast. Come hungry  - They're very generous with their portions.

We came in to a mostly empty restaurant and our party of 7 was seated immediately. Our server was really friendly and gave us some great recommendations for food. He explained that this was the new location that they opened up only a few months ago, and that they had better food than what was down the street that people waited hours in line for. He was even nice enough to see me shivering and he turned down the AC for me!

I got a small cup of Chicken and Andouille Gumbo, my friend got the Red Beans and Rice, and my other friend got the Combination Plate. All three were delicious, but the gumbo and the cornbread were particularly amazing. 

Right when we were leaving it started to get really busy so get here early!
This is my second time here, once for breakfast and now for lunch. They do not disappoint. This should be a staple in your breakfast/brunch rotation

This place used to be a church so the interior is super cool! I went at peak dinner time on Saturday so it was pretty packed. Finding a place to park was also a bit of a pain. Our party of 3 had about a 45 min wait so we hung out at the bar to pass the time. Service was friendly but kind of slow (understandable given how busy it was). I got the lamb burger, and it was delicious. Will definitely come back but maybe at a different time.

I grew up in Abington and used to make a career out of shopping at the Willow Grove Mall, and yet I had never been to this restaurant. My aunt and I stopped in one afternoon for a late lunch. We were almost the only table in the place and I was stunned by the rich decor and Chinese feel of the place. Our waiter was proficient and quickly served up our fried dumplings (amazing, best thing we ordered) and my chicken with cashews, which had the exact right brown sauce and crispy veggies. It was really very good! I've been missing out all these years...
We looooooved this place! We sat on the second story balcony, and watched 12th South for about 2 hours! The coffee is delicious, we never wanted to leave! White Bison, You will be missed!

Ok, so how I really feel. It sucks you can't call them to order, see a menu online, call them in general, need to order there, no seats, pizza was ok but my mouth was sore after eating 3 slices. Not great leftover cold either. Cheesesteak could use more meat or just cut your bread length a bit shorter.

I am big on leaving a good review if I'm 100% satisfied and I definitely left being 100% satisfied. My husband and I told the servers it was our first time, they had no problem explaining to us how things went. We got to sample some of the meat options before we actually picked what we wanted as our meal and when I tell you the food is AFFORDABLE!! I paid around $30 after taxes for 2 entrees, a side of meat and 2 drinks.. When I go to my now second favorite Caribbean place I leave out paying more for the same amount which to me is why they're now 2nd and this is now my 1st ! 
Customer service is amazing and I didn't get a chance to gather the names but a gentleman and a nice lady helped us and didn't seem irritated that it took us a little while to get our mind together on what we wanted to order. 
The oxtails were good, I wish they it was more meat and less bone and fat but the flavor was definitely there. The goat is amazing and very meaty, the yellow rice definitely made the dish great. 
Long review short, if you're looking to take a chance on some good food for the family, date night or even just a meal for yourself please come here. I will be returning for the pork chunks next time ! 
Food : 9/10
Service : 10/10
Quality : 10/10

Went for dinner. Gin drink was good, and food was fine but fish entree was embarrassingly small. Couldn't have been 2 ounces and it was red snapper...not even a high end fish. Waitress apologized but didn't do anything about it.

Food came out fresh and right on time, price was reasonable, staff was friendly and accommodating.  They helped provide an order that wasn't on the menu. I'm a huge fan of the bowls as I had the Oaxaca bowl at the Seminole location. The store was clean and inviting. I'm glad I discovered the store as I would greatly return. I've been in the plaza several times and missed it as it's tucked away towards the corner of the plaza. I would highly recommend anyone who loves fresher ingredients and healthier foods to try Freshii.

Fraudulent charge on my credit card. Seriously, almost $1300 worth of Hank's Supermarket stuff?? And no one at Hank's batted an eye?? Come on. And before you say anything, the credit card company told me EXACTLY where you are located, so I know I have the correct place. Thank God for American Express!!

I really loved the food and my waitress was very sweet, however I have to give two stars because of how rude and off putting the support staff were. First impression I walk in and the two blonde hostesses are so disrespectful they didn't even acknowledge me and I had to say something to them. Even then, they were so put out on the fact that they even had to talk to me. Then the busser has the worst attitude ever, he didn't even make eye contact and had a dirty look on his face the whole time. Thank you to the short blonde haired waitress and the red haired food runner for saving this experience, the waitress took great care of us and answered all of our questions. Those hostesses really need an attitude check.
Pretty good! I had the Pacemaker which is 2 different Benedictts! I had Chicken St. Charles and the Eggs Cochon. Both were good! Chicken was a bit dry but the hollandaise sauce helped! I'll be back!

We had 4 in our party. 2 people  got a pizza, 1 a chicken pasta dish and I got a ham/salami sub. First the meals all came out at different times. The pasta dish was soaked in oil and my sub had hardly any meat. The sub was $9. It was pretty sad. Subway subs makes their subs with a whole lot more meat and a lot less. Pizza was good but not worth the $23. I was very disappointed and will not come back.

Waitress with the interesting hair color was incredibly hostile and rude to me and my son for ZERO reason. Told her which way was up and started walking out (I've never before in my life done that) when the manager saw what was happening and stopped us and asked us to stay. We did reluctantly and he took over the service and comped everything, which was nice. There was clearly something about the way we looked that triggered her. No stars for her, four for the manager.

Great service and meal :)

Went in Aug 22, 2019 and tried their Coolinary Month menu and a Carolina Oyster Sandwich.

Had the Chilled Sweet Corn Soup, Crispy Smoked Quail and Brown Butter Cake.

I like the sweet corn soup but didn't think the cream was needed. I also think it might have tasted better hot.

The smoked quail was good but ricotta didn't seem necessary either. I think the smashed peas were great :)

The Carolina oyster sandwich was tasty :) the oyster was perfectly crispy and sauce was great

The star of the night was the brown butter cake! Oh man, it was fabulous and the flavors were so well balanced. The Chantilly cream is also housemade.

I would got back just for that cake!

If I could do 1 1/2. I would. Pure rudeness. 
I walked into the wrong gate on accident & one of their servers was very rude telling me disrespectfully I'm not suppose to be there. As escorting me out stated it was a private party. Was happy to leave but he was very rude.
.
Wow what a great meal. Salsa is fresh and the Mexican street corn is the best! Ask for it off the cob! Have the jalapeño chicken or the flautas they are great.

We seriously had the best time! Awesome happy hour. Wish I could remember our servers name, but he had curly orange hair and was the sweetest, most informative, and made our time here a blast. Will certainly be back!

My wife's Mahi Mahi was NOT worth the $18 price tag attached to her dish!  What showed up was a VERY SMALL, around four or five bite sized, PIECE of fish that was not worth passing up other nearby restaurants just to eat here.

Plus, when you order and appetizer that is fried chicken bites it should not take over 15 minutes to get to your table.  The table beside us ordered after us and received their chicken tenders (nearly the same thing) several minutes before ours while our Daughter had to hungrily wait longer than necessary.

Their burger was properly cooked to temperature, and the service was sub par as our waitress was so with other tables we had to get the attention of several other servers just to get the items we required just to get through our meal.

This was a Lunch on a Sunday early afternoon with not many people in the restaurant.  The service should have been a lot better to go along with a MUCH LARGER piece of fish.

If you want good Mahi Mahi go to Circles in Apollo Beach!  You receive two large fillets for $24 that taste excellent!

Tried to make reservations for 8:15 pm. They were busy. Got a table at 9 pm. It was wonderful. The staff is hospitable. The food is great. Portions are beyond generous. I had vitello saltimboca as a main. My wife had chicken with jumbo shrimps. Both cooked to perfection. Sauce not too heavy. Everything great. The calamari as an appetizer was perfect. Hot, crispy batter with tender meat inside.

My husband and I love the Noble Crust location in Wesley chapel and love going for brunch. Long story short, I was in the area one evening for work and he was with me so we decided to give this location a try for dinner. We order the Margarita 2.0 pizza, skillet garlic knots, and their crispy fried chicken wings. 

Everything was delicious. The skillet knots were warm and perfectly seasoned. The wings were sweet, spicy and crispy. The pizza was garnished with all our favorite vegetables and whipped ricotta on top. It also reheated very nicely in our air fryer the next say since we didn't get to finish all the delicious food. 

Our server was attentive and kind when we asked to move to another table as we were seated under an AC vent that made it a bit chilly for me.
This was the best service I've New Orleans. The waiter was excellent with bringing food and drinks. Music was delightful by allow our friend to sing with them. Couldn't ask for a better experience!

As usually this is my
Favorite restaurant. Today we celebrated my daughter 26 b day with a great bottle of wine and steaks.

Spent 10 minutes of my time waiting for my order to be taken. One of the workers at the countet did not acknowledge me at all, instead he fiddled with his phone. The other worker finally acknowledged me by letting me know that she would be with me. Five minutes passed, I finally left.
